def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    qualified_expenses = 8500
    magi = 85000
    credit_rate = 0.20
    phase_out_start = 80000
    phase_out_end = 90000

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    eligible_expenses = min(qualified_expenses, 10000)
    potential_credit = eligible_expenses * credit_rate

    if magi >= phase_out_end:
        llc_credit = 0.0
    elif magi > phase_out_start:
        phase_out_fraction = (phase_out_end - magi) / (phase_out_end - phase_out_start)
        llc_credit = potential_credit * phase_out_fraction
    else:
        llc_credit = potential_credit

    # return answer
    return round(llc_credit, 2)
